    import calendar
    cal = calendar.Calendar()
    # Find all the days of the given weekday in this month
    days = [d for d in cal.itermonthdays2(year, month) if d[1] == weekday_num]
    # The last such day is the one with the highest day-of-month
    last_day = max(days, key=lambda x: x[0])
    return day == last_day[0]
